content.objective: Establish a deterministic provider-neutral planning-only WorkBreakdown module.

scope.boundary: WorkBreakdown 0.1.0 planning semantics in the existing DevRelay kernel.
in: Coverage gate and typed delta promotion

content.problemSummary: Approved scope needs complete bounded work without coupling Core to a planner or allowing plans to imply execution.
content.solutionSummary: Use one state-routed module with context-neutral validators, a ProjectWorkBreakdownState-registered preflight producer, configured planner, authoritative gate, approved baseline observers, and trusted contributor.
requirementsDrivers: No execution or graph authority in adapters
behaviorFlows: Core loads exact state and derives establish-breakdown or decompose-change.
Registered preflight schema-validates and durably checkpoints baseline_drift under its own producer identity before adapter entry; replay never enters the adapter.
On pass, the configured planner returns one canonical candidate.
Approved requirements and architecture observers, plus applicable contract observer, run before candidate WorkItem edges; ApprovedNotApplicable forbids contract refs.
Gate derives coverage, resolves current evidence, owns no-work approval, and promotes or deterministically applies an exact delta.
dataResponsibilities: ProjectWorkBreakdownState owns routing and exact lineage.
Context-neutral validators own upstream schema and semantic checks.
Guard checkpoints bind producer, invocation fingerprint, result schema, and replay.
ApprovedChangePackage binds approval evidence plus pre-change and target requirements, architecture, contract disposition, repository, graph, and work baseline.
Gate owns coverage universe, already-satisfied evidence resolution, no-work approval, deterministic delta application, and full-result binding.
Traceability 1.1 contract digest binds horizons, node kinds, edge kinds, and endpoint-policy version while retaining the implementation horizon.
failureHandling: Version, digest, revision, tree, disposition, or change-package lineage mismatch yields baseline_drift with no candidate and zero adapter calls.
Guard result or checkpoint mismatch fails closed.
Gate rejects uncovered scope, unscoped work, invalid refs, unresolved evidence, or unapproved no-work.
Delta rejects duplicate targets, add-existing, update/retire-missing, prior-digest mismatch, replacement mismatch, or result not bound to exact ordered operations.
securityPrivacy: WorkBreakdown adapter grants allow exact reads, planning-artifact writes, and implementation-engine bridge only; process, build, and source-tree writes are forbidden.
ContractBaseline and ApprovedNotApplicable are explicit authority-bearing unions.
performanceReliabilityOperability: All effect and guard checkpoints replay deterministically.
Graph updates checkpoint before atomic merge.
A 1.1 update may extend a valid 1.0 snapshot only as a 1.1 child preserving exact parent and update lineage.
compatibilityMigrationRollout: Traceability validator recognizes exact legacy 1.0 vocabulary and kinds; WorkBreakdown contributors emit 1.1 only.
Spec Kit tasks and OpenSpec tasks are configuration defaults, not fixed routing.
verificationIntent: Test both routes, adapter swap, drift zero-call replay, schemas, coverage, promotion, traceability ordering, and Core scans.
Test literal WorkItemDraft keys and deliverable-oriented work types.
Test unique-target add/update/retire preconditions, deterministic apply order, and resulting baseline digest.
Test traceability 1.0 validation, 1.1 update migration, 1.1 child identity, and preserved parent/update replay lineage.

assumptions.statement: The package inputs are the exact approved WorkBreakdown requirements pair.

risks.statement: Native planner formats could leak into the canonical contract.
risks.impact: Adapter replacement would change module semantics.
risks.mitigation: Normalize into provider-neutral artifacts and retain native files only as subordinate evidence.

risks.statement: Coverage accounting could become ceremony without correctness value.
risks.impact: Workflow cost rises while gaps remain.
risks.mitigation: Derive the exact universe mechanically and require concise evidence-bearing dispositions.

risks.statement: Dependency hints could be treated as an authoritative DAG.
risks.mitigation: Mark hints non-authoritative and reserve DAG validation for WorkDependencyAnalysis.

risks.statement: Existing projects could be forced to reconstruct historical work.
risks.mitigation: Use establish-breakdown when no baseline exists and plan only current approved scope.

risks.statement: Generated work items may not be independently executable or verifiable.
risks.mitigation: Gate bounded scope, deliverables, verification plan, evidence, and controlled work type.

risks.statement: Planning edges could imply implementation or verification.
risks.mitigation: Emit only candidate planning edges and activate them at the Gate; factual edges remain downstream.

risks.statement: Stale baselines or repository state may reach the planner.
risks.impact: Work is decomposed against unauthorized inputs.
risks.mitigation: Run the registered preflight before adapter entry and checkpoint/replay baseline_drift.

risks.statement: Traceability 1.1 migration could corrupt legacy lineage.
risks.impact: Graph replay or audit becomes unverifiable.
risks.mitigation: Recognize exact 1.0, emit 1.1 only for WorkBreakdown, and preserve parent/update lineage in the 1.1 child.

risks.statement: Declarative planning-only grants may not be enforced by a host.
risks.impact: A planner could perform forbidden build or source writes.
risks.mitigation: Require host enforcement evidence and fail release conformance when process/build/source-tree effects are observed.
